proposed_comments.title: Handle alternate JSON representations before accepting zero matches

confidence.rationale: The byte-level scanner and early return are directly visible at the pinned head; exploitability depends on a copied backup/log using one of these noncanonical but valid representations.

proposed_comments.body: A backup containing `{"Secur\u0069tyKey":{"value":"fixture-key"}}` has a valid `SecurityKey` member, but this literal search finds no properties and the pairing key is archived unchanged. JSON serialized inside a quoted log field (`\"SecurityKey\":...`) also bypasses the scan. Match decoded member names and embedded payloads, and exclude records that cannot be sanitized safely; add regression fixtures for both representations.

proposed_comments.title: Reject historical GETSECKEY records during sanitization

confidence.rationale: Pinned staging and scanner behavior are direct, and history confirms the old writer; applicability is limited because the writer was DEBUG-only and removed before the current head.

proposed_comments.body: A historical MWB `GETSECKEY: <key>` record contains no quoted `SecurityKey` property, so this scan can report zero matches and export the pairing key unchanged, including in backup logs. Detect the legacy marker during the streaming scan and reject the affected staged file before the zero-match return. Add regression fixtures with ordinary diagnostics and a marker split across read chunks.

proposed_comments.title: Handle alternate JSON representations before accepting zero matches

confidence.rationale: The byte-level scanner and early return are directly visible at the pinned head; exploitability depends on a copied backup/log using one of these noncanonical but valid representations.

proposed_comments.body: A UTF-16LE/BE backup containing an ordinary `SecurityKey` produces zero matches because NUL bytes separate the ASCII characters, so its pairing key enters the ZIP unchanged. Reject unsupported encodings before accepting a zero-match result, or decode them before scanning; rejecting NUL-containing text lets the existing failure handling omit the staged file. Add regression fixtures for both byte orders.
